name: AlienVault OTX
tagline: Open threat exchange with pulses, indicators, and community threat intel
description: AlienVault Open Threat Exchange (OTX) is a community-driven threat intelligence platform that provides access to pulses, indicators of compromise (IOCs), and related threat data via a REST API. Developers use it to enrich security tooling with shared threat intelligence from the OTX community.

auth.details: API key via X-OTX-API-KEY header, self-serve signup at otx.alienvault.com

use_cases: look up threat indicators by IP, domain, hash, or URL
fetch OTX pulses and their indicators of compromise
get subscribed pulse updates for threat feeds
enrich security alerts with community threat context
search pulses related to a malware family or campaign
